in_hindi.name: चंद्रहास
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from 'Chandra' (Moon) and 'haas' (mustard seed), symbolizing the laughter of the moon god.

in_tamil.name: சந்திரகாலயம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A name derived from 'Chandra' (Moon) and 'kālayam' (god), representing the deity of the moon in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: చంద్రహాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A name derived from 'Chandra' (Moon) and 'haasu' (mustard seed), symbolizing the seed of the moon god.

in_marathi.name: Chandrahaas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrahaas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrahaas derives from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Haas' meaning horse. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is often depicted as riding a horse. Thus, Chandrahaas can be interpreted as 'Moon Rider'.
